observable.character_coefficient: C_chi(omega)=sum_(s in I) conjugate(chi(m_omega+s)), with chi extended by zero on nonunits
observable.normalized_squared_badness: W_omega=abs(R_omega)^2/(M_omega^2 Y^2), defined only on an outer-good domain with a certified positive survivor floor

finite_contracts.tower: E[1_O W]=sum_(a in O) P_A(a) E[W|A=a]

uniform_fiber.strength: stronger than the global or outer-good-conditional mean requirement

raw_moment_fallback.inputs: E[1_O abs(R)^2]<=rho, M_omega>=M_min>0 on O, Y>0
raw_moment_fallback.warning: an average survivor count cannot replace the pointwise M_min floor

source_screen.fmt_formula_1_1: Supplies the tower identity for an integrable variable and a countable conditioning variable, but no bound for W.
source_screen.fmt_theorem_4: Preserves cardinality for a fixed subset Q-double-prime; the subset is fixed before the output covering law is drawn and the printed rate is qualitative.
source_screen.fgkmt_corollary_4: Preserves cardinality of fixed Q-double-prime sets and derives from small-set survival probabilities; it does not state concentration for output-dependent signed or complex CRT weights.
source_screen.maier_1981: Uses Gallagher pointwise for each fixed admissible column after the CRT shift has been fixed; it does not average the shift under the FMT law.
source_screen.sono: Uses pointwise PAP for every fixed reduced residue before averaging the independent row variable z; z does not average over the construction-dependent CRT shift m.
source_screen.targeted_literature_search: No drop-in theorem was identified that simultaneously preserves the actual FMT covering success and gives a numerical second moment for the CRT-output-dependent complex character observable. This is a scoped source-screen result, not a proof that no such theorem exists.

minimal_new_analytic_lemma.preferred_global_form: Under the actual final FMT joint law, give an explicit finite upper bound for E[1_O abs(sum_(chi!=chi0) C_chi(omega)Z_chi(Y))^2/(M_omega^2Y^2)] that is strictly below tau^2(1-F_out)(1-F_in).
minimal_new_analytic_lemma.stronger_fiber_form: Uniformly for every outer-good A=a, give an explicit finite conditional upper bound mu_f with F_in+mu_f/tau^2<1.
required_scope: actual final output N-prime rather than preliminary independent edges
exceptional prime B0 and modulus P=P(x)/B0
positive pointwise survivor floor or direct normalized observable
numerical multiplier and common finite cutoff
the same law used by the finite covering proof
